_note: Gemma 4 12B fine-tuned for machines with 32 GB of memory (owner, 2026-11-02: 'We do need to try training our new Gemma model'). The MoE's recipe on the MoE's 1.0 data: dataset v2-20261101, 3 epochs, no early stopping, the last step exported, adapters of steps 300 and 575 kept for epoch twins. Bars on the 1.0 grader, first attempt (after repair), main / held-out: guided Gemma 4 12B at q8_0 48 (67) / 26 (41); e3 at mxfp4 (20.9 GB), the current 32 GB candidate, 64 (68) / 33 (40). Trained at 4-bit like the MoE; the served weights are the 16-bit merge.

family_config.description: Gemma 4 12B (model_type gemma4_unified): multimodal architecture trained on its text layers, needs transformers with gemma4_unified and a current Unsloth
family_config._evidence: 2026-11-02 probe of google/gemma-4-12B-it at 43c9d014 on training/config/images/Dockerfile.gemma4 (transformers 5.17.0, Unsloth 2026.10.11). With thinking off the generation prompt ends in an empty thought channel a finished turn lacks, so the trainer renders as served: 40 of 40 sampled records are prompt + content + <turn|>, and the served prompt's tokens are a prefix of the training tokens. The template emits the one <bos> and the tokenizer adds none, so nothing is stripped (Unsloth's Gemma 4 text recipe strips it; here that leaves none). The seven names match 328 Linear modules, all in language_model: the vision and audio parts have none of them. A merge keeps the base's weight names and changes only the seven targets, but transformers 5.17 rewrites config.json in a form vLLM's 5.13 cannot read (TypeError on num_global_key_value_heads), so the trainer restores the base's non-weight files.
